test.run: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider $(ls tests/acceptance/test_$(echo {item} | tr - _).py 2>/dev/null) tests/{item} --junitxml {out}/junit.xml

na.database: a file converter; it stores nothing
na.api-style: a command-line tool; no network API
na.authn-authz: runs locally on the user's own files
na.data-placement: no data leaves the user's machine
na.deployment: run from a checkout; nothing is deployed
na.observability: a one-shot command; its exit code and output are the signal
na.security-review: reads one local file the user names; no inputs from others
na.licensing: an example inside this plugin; it ships under the plugin's licence
